name: comparison_status
description: Outcome of one forge observation of a repository (continuous-ops redesign step 1).

definitions.ok: Observed; compared with the audit when pushed since.
definitions.quota-deferred: Observed, but the comparison waits for forge quota.
definitions.no-pinned-sha: Observed; the audit pinned no commit, so nothing to compare against (routes to a full audit).
definitions.unsupported-host: The repository's host is not a supported forge.
definitions.no-repo-url: The repository has no URL to observe.
definitions.no-credentials: The forge refused for lack of credentials.
definitions.unreachable: The forge could not be reached.
definitions.error: The forge answered with an error or a response that failed validation.
definitions.ban-suspected: Skipped: a streak of errors suggests a forge secondary rate-limit ban.
definitions.network-skipped: Skipped: the run was told not to use the network.
definitions.never-audited: Not observed: there is no audit to compare against (bootstrap).

standard.none: Project-defined observation outcomes; no external standard applies.
